response.why: Take the play: aggro wants the tempo half-turn; on the play our curve lands before stompy's bigger bodies stabilize.
First land of the game after a mana-screwed start (life already 16 from Bears beats). Play Mountain immediately; next turns cast Kird Ape then hold Bolt for their best threat or the face.

Develop with the one mana we have: Kird Ape (a 1/1 here, no Forest on our side, but a body that can block or chip). Bolt stays in hand — belief says every stompy hand is packed with 3-4 toughness bodies (Courser, Baloth) so face or a key threat later beats Bolting a 2/2 Bears now.
Upkeep, nothing to do at instant speed that beats waiting: pass, draw, then act in main. Bolt still held.
Drew Swiftspear, no land. Pass the draw step; cast it in main where it belongs (still sorcery-speed body).
Cast Monastery Swiftspear with our one Mountain. Two bodies now hold the ground against Bears while we dig for lands; prowess makes future burn double as combat tricks. Bolt still banked.
Upkeep, pass to draw. At 10 life we need to stabilize: if a land comes, the plan is chump-block math plus Bolt; nothing to do at instant speed now.

Drew a second Monstrous Rage, still one land. Pass the draw step. Note: blocks are stuck on auto-decline this game (bridge bug found: driver sends 'blockers'/'attackers' fields, wrapper checked 'options'), so the plan is to race, not trade.

Hold the single R open and pass to combat: their Bears are both tapped so the minimax attack should be clean, and casting Monstrous Rage AFTER attackers are declared gets the same prowess trigger with more information. Honest read: at 10 vs 20 with blocks bugged off, this race is very uphill.
Begin combat: pass through to declare-attackers, where the minimax search takes over. Mana stays open for Rage after attacks are locked in.

Minimax swung with both. Now Monstrous Rage on the attacking Swiftspear: +2/+0 plus the Monster Role and the prowess trigger turn a 1-power hit into ~5, no blockers possible. Best mana we can spend this turn in the race.
Rage targets our attacking Swiftspear (index 3): +2/+0 from Rage, +1/+1 Monster Role, +1/+1 prowess from the cast itself = 5 power through, unblockable this combat since both Bears are tapped.

Brutal turn: they Titanic Growth'd an unblocked Bears for 8 (10 -> 2) while our 6 came back (them at 14). At 2 life with blocks bugged off, ANY attack kills us, so defense is pointless -- it's all-in: pass upkeep, then maximize face damage every remaining priority.

Drew Mountain -- two lands this turn. Plan: play Mountain in main, minimax attacks, then Rage + Bolt in combat for ~11 total (them to 3). Not lethal (need 14) but if MAD stumbles for one turn, any attack finishes. Pass draw.
Play the second Mountain. Two mana up: Rage + Bolt land in combat after attackers are declared.
Land played; pass to combat with both Mountains open. Rage and Bolt fire after attackers are locked.
Pass begin combat; attacks go to the search.
Attackers locked. Rage first on Swiftspear (target next), Bolt to the face after -- each cast adds a prowess counter to the damage.
Swiftspear again: 2/3 base +2/+0 Rage +1/+1 role +1/+1 prowess = 6 power attacking, and Bolt next adds another prowess counter for 7.
Bolt now, at the face (target next): the extra prowess counter makes Swiftspear 7 power before damage. Attack total this turn: 7 + 1 = 8, plus 3 Bolt = 11 -> them to 3.
Face. Killing a Bears saves nothing (any attack at 2 life is lethal to us); every point at the dome shortens the only clock that matters.
